description: Text before and after a block child is laid out in anonymous blocks around it.

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 3.33% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 61.63% and the box is 44.0px off, so it fails.
